title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper C.A.T.S.: Memory and Control Flow Tracing for Whole-Program Performance Analysis
problem: Artifact evaluation and reproducibility assessment for performance analysis tracing tool.
motivation: Validate and document the reproducibility of whole-program memory and control flow tracing methodology.
method: A reviewer obtained the C.A.T.S. tool (which traces memory access patterns and program execution flow to analyze whole-program performance), along with its artifact description and evaluation instructions. The reviewer ran the tool following the paper's procedures to check whether it produced the expected results and worked when executed independently.
key_novelty: An independent evaluation confirmed that the C.A.T.S. performance tracing tool produces reproducible results when others follow the paper's experimental procedures.
baselines: Original paper: Ben-Nun et al., SC25
limitations: Reproducibility report only; no original technical contributions. Limited detail in abstract.
